main.description: Prove the address a contact-email link was sent to, as the account it was sent for. A change waiting for the link becomes the contact email. Opening the same link again answers the same. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

token.description: The token from the link's #t= fragment.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per action and resends on every retry of it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a customer nor staff, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, or the provisioner refused it as malformed.

errors.name: InvalidLink
errors.description: The token is unknown, belongs to another account, or a newer link replaced it.

errors.name: ExpiredLink
errors.description: The link is more than 24 hours old.

errors.name: EmailNotConfigured
errors.description: Owner email is not switched on yet.

errors.name: InvalidEmail
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner. Not expected here; declared because every contact-email refusal is mapped the same way.
